from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def r_(p, basis):
    k,m=p
    e=np.exp(-k*t)
    cols=basis(e,k,m)
    X=np.column_stack(cols)
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    return np.mean((X@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt), c
